rules.rule: Builds must never fetch PGP keys from the network. Flag any gpg --recv-keys, --receive-keys, --locate-keys or --locate-external-keys, pacman-key --recv-keys, or download of a key file in build scripts, bin/build, helpers, workflows that build packages, or a PKGBUILD. The only allowed places are bin/refresh-pgp-keys and the WKD lookup of Omarchy's own key in build/Dockerfile.

Every fingerprint added to validpgpkeys must ship as pkgbuilds/<package>/keys/pgp/<FINGERPRINT>.asc in the same PR. A key file must be named by the full uppercase fingerprint of the primary key it contains; flag a mismatch, and flag a key file that holds more than one primary key.
